items.label: Chồng bí ngô khắc mặt
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game decoration sprite master for Hagrid Farm. Crisp chunky handcrafted pixel art, cosy spooky wizarding garden, 2:1 dimetric/isometric projection on a 64x32 logical tile. Top-left illumination; selective dark-purple outlines, no pure black/white; clear big pixel clusters, no small noisy texture, no antialiasing, no gradients, no blur. Palette ONLY #231F2E #4A3042 #735044 #A57554 #874056 #C75B4B #ED8A45 #FFC36B #24483F #3F6A45 #71934B #B0BD67. Use 2-3 of those color ramps per object. Native look must match the rustic pumpkin, broom-rack, mandrake and wooden hut sprites in the conversation reference. TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no scenery, no platform or tile base unless part of the actual subject, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Keep every part including glow as hard-edged pixels. Output ONE wide horizontal sprite master containing exactly TWO separated views of the SAME item: LEFT half default isometric view, RIGHT half the alternate isometric view rotated 90 degrees, NOT a mirror. Both views same size, same baseline near bottom, each fully contained in its own half with generous transparent margins, no overlap. Ground footprints consistent between views. Top-left light stays top-left in BOTH views. This is one asset turnaround sheet, not two different designs.
STRICT TRANSPARENCY: Outside the solid subject EVERY pixel is fully transparent. No soft aura, no vignette, no colored or black background, no cast shadow. Internal light uses hard-edged flat pixel clusters only. Both views fully inside image, consistent ground baseline, generous transparent margins.
SUBJECT: A compact stack of exactly three different carved jack-o-lantern pumpkins, one wearing a tiny crooked witch hat; varied cheerful spooky faces and candlelit amber interiors. Green stems, a few autumn leaves at the feet. A sturdy pyramid silhouette, no pedestal.
Logical native canvas 96x112 per view. Keep readable chunky shapes suitable for this native size; no fine painterly detail. Same physical item in exactly TWO separate views. Never add people, backdrop or letters.
